work: Qualified the former combined Skypark Macau Tower clue against official Park and StandaloneAttraction searches. No Macau Tower or Bungy entity existed; the generic hidden SkyPark Park has no location and holds a retired Cyclone roller coaster, so is unrelated. Created the Macau Tower Bungy Jump as a separately ticketed fixed attraction, with eight descriptions, official current price and access rules, two exact licensed photographs, eight public pages and two image binaries HTTP 200, and a published Facebook post.
qualification: Skypark Macau Tower offers several distinct activities in a tourist observation tower. This entry covers only the Bungy Jump; Skyjump, Skywalk and Tower Climb remain separate candidates. The historic 2009 photograph shows an actual Macau Tower Bungy jump; the 2023 photograph shows its Level 61 zone.
